summary: Add signed unified genesis snapshot export and offline verification
details: The snapshot tool can normalize exact-height full-replay and sealed AssumeUTXO databases into one SQLite artifact containing current balances, live UTXOs, the original genesis commit and the required script mappings.

Export and verification reuse existing snapshot keys, compare per-script balances with UTXOs and publish a source-independent logical digest. Production snapshot publishing, installation and node bootstrap integration remain separate planned stages.
